degradation.rule: 50% checkpoint (60/120 grid trainings): wall clock > 300s -> drop K=16 configs (criterion keeps K in {8,64}); hard stop at 540s
degradation.checkpoint_decision: wall clock 106.4s <= 300s at 60/120 -> keep full grid

metric_arbitration.main_decisive: corpus-level pooled exp(H) = exp(H(mean gate distribution)) over the 60-entity corpus (VQ/MoE code-perplexity caliber); collapse is definitionally a corpus-level phenomenon
metric_arbitration.assumption_free: raw used-codeword count: #{codes with mass share >= 1/60} (sensitivity >= 2/60); no entropy function involved
metric_arbitration.secondary: per-sample exp(H) (R2/EXP-07 caliber) - continuity reading only, no veto power; disagreements recorded, not silently resolved
metric_arbitration.calibration_gate: V0 (ReLU baseline) must read collapsed on all three pre-registered families: pooled exp(H) < 1.1, used@1/60 <= 2, per-sample exp(H) < 1.1, over all 18 configs (operationalization of instruction §2 'pooled exp(H)≈1、被使用码字≈1')

variants.v0: ReLU baseline: Linear(2048,256)->ReLU->Linear(256,K), forward only on the 18 Hub checkpoints (R2-identical pipeline; range-guarded to R2 incl. pooled field)
variants.v1: softmax-top-k gating: Linear(2048,256)->Linear(256,K)->softmax, top-k k=min(K,4) soft (renormalized) assignment; trained from scratch (weights not reused, structure only) with VQ reconstruction MSE
variants.v2: v1 + 1 resident shared code (always active, fixed assignment weight 1/(k+1), extra codebook row) + Switch-style aux loss L_aux = 0.01*K*sum_i f_i*P_i (f_i = batch top-k selection frequency, detached load; P_i = mean gate probability)

training.seed_rule: crc32('exp08|{config}|{seed_idx}') mod 1e6 + 20261023 (identical across v1/v2 -> paired comparison; distinct across configs -> independent replicates; distinct from EXP-07 base 20261022 -> cross-round independence)
training.init: hidden layer default PyTorch init; final gate layer ZERO-init (avoids softmax saturation at step 0 under raw-scale inputs, norm~165 - EXP-07 development benchmark); codebook DATA-init (batch rows + N(0, 0.01*std) noise, standard VQ practice)

method.grid: 24 training configs = K{8,16,64} x method{differentiable_pr,reinforce_ema} x preproc{raw,zscore} x variant{v1,v2}; method label NOMINAL for from-scratch VQ training (disclosed, as EXP-07); 5 seeds/config -> 120 grid trainings; training order K=8 -> K=64 -> K=16 (K=16 droppable at checkpoint). V0 covers all 18 .pt files (incl. preproc=none fed raw).
method.metrics: MAIN = pooled exp(H) (corpus-level); ASSUMPTION-FREE = used codewords @1/60 (sensitivity @2/60); SECONDARY = per-sample exp(H) (R2-identical); continuity stats retained

determinism_check.description: designated case v1|differentiable_pr|raw|K64, all 5 seeds: within-process 8-thread repeat vs main grid; two 1-thread runs
determinism_check.finding: 8-thread repeats are NOT expected to be bit-identical (threaded float reduction order, amplified over 300 chaotic training steps); 1-thread repeats are expected bit-identical. Single-run outcomes are therefore not bit-reproducible at 8 threads; all statistics rest on seed-level aggregation (5 seeds x 24 configs) and the float-noise-induced spread is disclosed as replicate variance. Cross-process float32 bit-reproducibility is not assumed in this sandbox (R2-ERRATUM finding); noise-aware tolerance 1e-5 for cross-round comparisons (WB0 1792678320 ruling).

Root cause: the gate expectation is mis-specified about the ReLU baseline's corpus-level behaviour - V0 is totally per-sample-collapsed (exp(H)=1.0000-1.0098, matching R2) but the corpus uses 1-9 codes (zscore arms route onto up to 9 codes at K=64). This is NOT an implementation defect: the pooled/used implementations reproduce R2's recorded effective_codes_pooled to max abs diff 1.41e-06 (<1e-5), and re-running cannot change V0's deterministic readings. Per the scope guard (no silent caliber change; 不得带着坏度量下结论) the verdict is BLOCKED and marked pending; full data + provisional verdict delivered for WB0 adjudication (accept the gate under the dead-code reading - used/K<=0.375 (K=64 arms ≈0.14), pooled/K<=0.324 (K=64 arms ≈0.11), per-sample≈1 - and accept the provisional verdict, or direct a re-run).
